characterSelection.title: Character Selection
characterSelection.subtitle: Choose your game mode and characters

validation.playerCountRequired: Please select a player count between 5 and 10
validation.moduleRequired: At least one module must be selected

gameMaster.title: Game Master
gameMaster.speechNotSupported: Speech synthesis is not supported in your browser. You can still read the script manually.
gameMaster.narrationInProgress: Game narration is in progress. Each step will be spoken aloud with pauses.

loyal-servant.name: Loyal Servant of Arthur
loyal-servant.description: Basic good character with no special abilities.

untrustworthy-servant.name: Untrustworthy Servant
untrustworthy-servant.description: Appears Evil to @:characters.merlin.name . Knows the @:characters.assassin.name . Cannot play Quest Fail card. Can become Evil during the Recruitment phase.

untrustworthy-servant-assassin.name: Untrustworthy Servant
untrustworthy-servant-assassin.description: Appears Evil to @:characters.merlin.name . Knows @:characters.morgana.name . Cannot play Quest Fail card. Can become Evil during the Recruitment phase.

assassin.name: Assassin
assassin.description: May activate Assassination stage if three Quests succeed.

morgana-assassin.name: Morgana
morgana-assassin.description: Appears as @:characters.merlin.name . May activate Assassination stage if three Quests succeed.

oberon.name: Oberon
oberon.description: Unknown to Evil. Does not know Evil.

minion-of-mordred.name: Minion of Mordred | Minions of Mordred

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: May Fail only the first three Quests.

revealer.name: Revealer
revealer.description: Reveals loyalty after second failed Quest.

evil-rogue.name: Evil Rogue
evil-rogue.description: May play Rogue Fail. Unknown to Evil. Does not know Evil.

evil-sorcerer.name: Evil Sorcerer
evil-sorcerer.description: May play Magic. May not play Fail.

leader.name: Leader
leader.description: The first quest leader with special responsibilities.

gameScript.initialSpeech: Everyone close your eyes and extend your hands into fists in front of you.
gameScript.minionsReveal: {minions}, {names}. Open your eyes and see your fellow evil players.
gameScript.minionsRevealWithHidden: {minions}, {visibleNames} but not {hiddenNames}. Open your eyes and see your fellow evil players.
gameScript.closeEyes: Now, close your eyes and reform your hands into fists.
gameScript.merlinOpen: @:characters.merlin.name , open your eyes and see the characters who appear evil to you.
gameScript.percivalSees: {names}. Extend your thumbs so @:characters.percival.name can see you.
gameScript.clericCheck: @:characters.leader.name , extend your thumb if you are evil.
gameScript.clericOpen: @:characters.cleric.name , open your eyes and see the alignment of the @:characters.leader.name .
gameScript.untrustworthySees: {names}. Extend your thumb so the @:characters.untrustworthy-servant.name can see you.
gameScript.untrustworthyOpen: @:characters.untrustworthy-servant.name , open your eyes and see the {names}.
gameScript.lancelots: Lancelots. It's your turn now. Open your eyes to reveal your counterpart.
gameScript.seniorMessengerSees: {names}. Extend your thumb so the @:characters.senior-messenger.name can see you.
gameScript.seniorMessengerOpen: @:characters.senior-messenger.name , open your eyes and see the {names}.
gameScript.gameBegins: Everyone open your eyes. The game begins!
